name: t-answer-ndr
description: OctoBus service for Chaitin T-Answer (TA, 全悉/Quanxi) NDR full-traffic detection security operations APIs. Network/user-permission configuration APIs are intentionally excluded.

chaitin.t_answer_ndr.v1.TAnswerNdrServic.name: search-attack-records
chaitin.t_answer_ndr.v1.TAnswerNdrServic.description: Scenario tool: search alert records by exact attack_name, keyword, attacker_ip, victim_ip, asset_ip, severity, result, and days or explicit Unix-ms time range.

chaitin.t_answer_ndr.v1.TAnswerNdrServic.name: analyze-ip-activity
chaitin.t_answer_ndr.v1.TAnswerNdrServic.description: Scenario tool: correlate one IP across assets, attacker-side alerts, victim-side alerts, and optional raw logs. Use role=any, attacker, or victim.

chaitin.t_answer_ndr.v1.TAnswerNdrServic.name: hunt-threats
chaitin.t_answer_ndr.v1.TAnswerNdrServic.description: Scenario tool: threat hunting over recent alerts. Provide query or attack_name plus optional IP/severity filters; returns matching alerts and top attacker/victim/attack-name aggregations.

chaitin.t_answer_ndr.v1.TAnswerNdrServic.name: investigate-attack-campaign
chaitin.t_answer_ndr.v1.TAnswerNdrServic.description: Report tool: investigate an attack campaign by query or attack_name and return distilled totals, top attack names, top attackers, top victims, sample alerts, and pivot IPs.

chaitin.t_answer_ndr.v1.TAnswerNdrServic.name: assess-ip-threat-profile
chaitin.t_answer_ndr.v1.TAnswerNdrServic.description: Report tool: assess one IP as attacker and victim, returning alert totals, top related entities, sample alerts, and optional traffic-log totals.

chaitin.t_answer_ndr.v1.TAnswerNdrServic.name: update-custom-intelligence-status
chaitin.t_answer_ndr.v1.TAnswerNdrServic.description: Enable or disable custom threat intelligence.

chaitin.t_answer_ndr.v1.TAnswerNdrServic.name: update-custom-rule-status
chaitin.t_answer_ndr.v1.TAnswerNdrServic.description: Enable or disable custom detection rules.

chaitin.t_answer_ndr.v1.TAnswerNdrServic.name: delete-alarm-white-list
chaitin.t_answer_ndr.v1.TAnswerNdrServic.description: Delete, enable, or disable alarm whitelist rules.

chaitin.t_answer_ndr.v1.TAnswerNdrServic.name: update-firewall-white-list-status
chaitin.t_answer_ndr.v1.TAnswerNdrServic.description: Enable or disable response-disposal whitelist entries.

chaitin.t_answer_ndr.v1.TAnswerNdrServic.name: update-block-rules-status
chaitin.t_answer_ndr.v1.TAnswerNdrServic.description: Enable, disable, or delete block rules.

chaitin.t_answer_ndr.v1.TAnswerNdrServic.name: upload-pcap-detect-files
chaitin.t_answer_ndr.v1.TAnswerNdrServic.description: Upload pcap or pcapng files for offline detection. Uses service-held web console credentials when needed.

chaitin.t_answer_ndr.v1.TAnswerNdrServic.name: create-pcap-detect-task
chaitin.t_answer_ndr.v1.TAnswerNdrServic.description: Create an offline pcap detection task from uploaded file ids. Uses service-held web console credentials when needed.

chaitin.t_answer_ndr.v1.TAnswerNdrServic.name: delete-pcap-detect-task
chaitin.t_answer_ndr.v1.TAnswerNdrServic.description: Delete an offline pcap detection task. Uses service-held web console credentials when needed.

chaitin.t_answer_ndr.v1.TAnswerNdrServic.name: analyze-pcap-files
chaitin.t_answer_ndr.v1.TAnswerNdrServic.description: Upload pcap files, create offline detection tasks, optionally wait for completion, and return related alerts. Uses service-held web console credentials when needed.

chaitin.t_answer_ndr.v1.TAnswerNdrServic.name: get-pcap-detect-alert
chaitin.t_answer_ndr.v1.TAnswerNdrServic.description: Get offline pcap detection alert details.

chaitin.t_answer_ndr.v1.TAnswerNdrServic.name: get-pcap-detect-alert-raw-document
chaitin.t_answer_ndr.v1.TAnswerNdrServic.description: Get raw offline pcap detection alert document.

chaitin.t_answer_ndr.v1.TAnswerNdrServic.name: create-tcpdump-process
chaitin.t_answer_ndr.v1.TAnswerNdrServic.description: Create an online packet capture task.

chaitin.t_answer_ndr.v1.TAnswerNdrServic.name: update-tcpdump-process
chaitin.t_answer_ndr.v1.TAnswerNdrServic.description: Update an online packet capture task.

chaitin.t_answer_ndr.v1.TAnswerNdrServic.name: start-tcpdump-process
chaitin.t_answer_ndr.v1.TAnswerNdrServic.description: Start an online packet capture task.

chaitin.t_answer_ndr.v1.TAnswerNdrServic.name: cancel-tcpdump-process
chaitin.t_answer_ndr.v1.TAnswerNdrServic.description: Cancel an online packet capture task.

chaitin.t_answer_ndr.v1.TAnswerNdrServic.name: download-file
chaitin.t_answer_ndr.v1.TAnswerNdrServic.description: Download a file from the unified download API.

chaitin.t_answer_ndr.v1.TAnswerNdrServic.name: count-alerts
chaitin.t_answer_ndr.v1.TAnswerNdrServic.description: Count threat alerts with raw JSON-RPC params.

chaitin.t_answer_ndr.v1.TAnswerNdrServic.name: list-alert-chart
chaitin.t_answer_ndr.v1.TAnswerNdrServic.description: Get threat alert time-series chart data.

chaitin.t_answer_ndr.v1.TAnswerNdrServic.name: load-alert-pcap-file
chaitin.t_answer_ndr.v1.TAnswerNdrServic.description: Load an alert pcap file for frame inspection.

chaitin.t_answer_ndr.v1.TAnswerNdrServic.name: list-alert-pcap-frames
chaitin.t_answer_ndr.v1.TAnswerNdrServic.description: List frames from a loaded alert pcap.

chaitin.t_answer_ndr.v1.TAnswerNdrServic.name: filter-alert-pcap-frames
chaitin.t_answer_ndr.v1.TAnswerNdrServic.description: Filter frames from an alert pcap using Wireshark-style filters.

chaitin.t_answer_ndr.v1.TAnswerNdrServic.name: get-alert-pcap-frame
chaitin.t_answer_ndr.v1.TAnswerNdrServic.description: Get one frame from an alert pcap.

chaitin.t_answer_ndr.v1.TAnswerNdrServic.name: check-alert-pcap-download
chaitin.t_answer_ndr.v1.TAnswerNdrServic.description: Check whether alert pcap download is available.

chaitin.t_answer_ndr.v1.TAnswerNdrServic.name: download-pcap
chaitin.t_answer_ndr.v1.TAnswerNdrServic.description: Create or fetch a pcap download for matching traffic.

chaitin.t_answer_ndr.v1.TAnswerNdrServic.name: multi-download-pcap
chaitin.t_answer_ndr.v1.TAnswerNdrServic.description: Create or fetch multi-pcap downloads for matching traffic.

chaitin.t_answer_ndr.v1.TAnswerNdrServic.name: search-traffic-logs
chaitin.t_answer_ndr.v1.TAnswerNdrServic.description: Scenario tool: search original traffic logs with typed protocol, src_ip, dest_ip, ip, keyword, days, count, and offset. protocol supports all, http, dns, tcp_udp, and other.

chaitin.t_answer_ndr.v1.TAnswerNdrServic.name: multi-download-log-json
chaitin.t_answer_ndr.v1.TAnswerNdrServic.description: Create or fetch JSON exports for original logs.
